```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`DSEMr` estimates single-level (`N=1`) and two-level dynamic confirmatory
factor models using multivariate forward-filtering backward-sampling (FFBS) in
both direct autoregressive factor score (DAFS) and white-noise factor score
(WNFS) parameterizations, with full item-wise missing-data integration and
conditional Deviance Information Criterion (`DIC` / `pD`).

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

m_dafs <- dsem_model("
  f =~ y1 + y2 + y3
  f ~ lag(f, 1)
", time = "time")

dat_lat <- simulate_dsem(
  m_dafs, n = 80, ar = 0.5, loadings = c(1, 0.85, 1.15),
  residual_sd = c(0.4, 0.45, 0.4), seed = 26
)

fit_dafs <- dsem(m_dafs, dat_lat, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 27)
coef(fit_dafs)
dsem_dic(fit_dafs)
head(dsem_inspect(fit_dafs, "latent_states"))
```

White-noise factor score (WNFS, Mplus Example 6.26b), multi-factor cross-lagged
dynamic SEM (Mplus 6.28 and 9.36), and two-level dynamic CFA (Mplus 9.34) are
compiled and estimated directly through the same `dsem()` interface.
